meta.name: competitive-research-snapshot
meta.description: Research a competitive landscape with cited snapshots, a comparison matrix, and so-what implications. Use when a product decision needs competitive grounding, not a market report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成竞品对比矩阵与行动建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做产品决策前需要快速了解竞品格局
copy.tagline_en: Generate competitive comparison matrix and actionable insights quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick competitive grounding before product decisions

howto.what: 让Claude按固定流程做竞品研究：先出搜索计划，选约3个关键竞品，只查够用的信息，每条标注为事实/推断/假设并附真实来源，输出带对比矩阵和启示的固定格式快照。
howto.when: 当产品决策需要竞争依据（定位、路线图、交易支持等），且要的不是市场报告时触发。

say.text: 研究一下我们和竞品A、竞品B，支持定位改写。
say.note: 会进入流程并输出带引用快照。

say.text: 做一份竞争快照，对比三家竞品的目标客户和强弱项。
say.note: 会生成固定格式的对比矩阵。

say.text: 给出竞品分析中的三个待验证假设。
say.note: 会从快照中提取假设项。

howto.what_en: Claude runs competitive research as a fixed workflow: search plan, ~3 key competitors, just-enough research, each finding labeled Fact/Inference/Assumption with real source URLs, and a stable-format snapshot with comparison matrix and so-what implications.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a product decision needs competitive grounding, not a market report — e.g., positioning, roadmap bet, deal support, board prep.

say_en.text: Research us vs Competitor A and B to support a positioning rewrite.
say_en.note: It will run the workflow and output a cited snapshot.

say_en.text: Produce a snapshot comparing three rivals' target customers and strengths.
say_en.note: A fixed comparison matrix will be generated.

say_en.text: List three assumptions to validate from the snapshot.
say_en.note: Claude will extract assumptions from it.
